description:
# Junior Meta Media Buyer (Full-Time)



We're looking for a motivated **Junior Meta Media Buyer** to join our growing e-commerce team.



This is a great opportunity for someone who already has experience launching Meta ads and wants to develop into a senior media buyer managing large advertising budgets.



### What you'll do



* Launch an average of **6 Meta campaigns per day**

* Carefully follow launch instructions and campaign structures

* Double-check every campaign for accuracy before publishing

* Work closely with the creative and marketing teams

* Learn advanced media buying skills over time, including:



  * Scaling winning campaigns

  * Creating Cost Cap campaigns

  * Performance analysis

  * Campaign optimization



### Requirements



* Experience launching ads inside Meta Ads Manager

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong reading comprehension and ability to follow instructions precisely

* Reliable, organized, and eager to learn

* Available **Monday through Saturday**

* Approximately **6 hours per day** (some days slightly more, some days less)

* You **cannot have another job** while working with us



### Salary



* Starting salary: **$700 USD per month**

* This is a fixed monthly salary.



As you grow into a **Senior Media Buyer**, your income can increase significantly through salary raises and performance bonuses. Successful senior media buyers can earn **2–3x** the starting salary.



### Application Instructions (Important)



To make sure applicants actually read the vacancy carefully, we have one simple test.



Your application **must**:



* Start with the word **"mango"**

* Be written entirely by **you**

* **Do not use AI** to write your application



If your application does not start with the word **"mango"**, or it is clearly AI-generated, **we will not read it**. This is our first screening step.



If you're detail-oriented, eager to grow, and want to build a long-term career in e-commerce media buying, we'd love to hear from you.

Standing on the Rock is a fast-growing educational ministry teaching Equity jurisprudence to students across the United States, Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, and beyond. Our founder Julian Swan teaches a live course that has helped hundreds of students resolve IRS matters, discharge debt, and protect their assets using lawful principles rooted in common law.

We are expanding our reach and need a motivated virtual assistant who can help us grow our audience, book interviews with podcasters and YouTubers, and manage our social media presence consistently.

This is a long-term role with a team that is doing meaningful work.



What You Will Be Doing

Podcast and YouTube Outreach

Research podcasters and YouTubers whose audiences align with our content

Send outreach messages to hosts on behalf of our founder to explore interview opportunities

Follow up with hosts who have not replied and track all outreach in a spreadsheet

Coordinate scheduling when a host says yes



Social Media

Post daily content across our social media platforms using pre-approved copy and graphics

Upload videos with minor edits such as trimming intros and adding captions

Track engagement and report weekly numbers



Ads and Funnels

Assist with testing landing pages and funnels using templates and instructions provided

Help manage ads on Google and social media platforms under close supervision



What We Are Looking For

Strong written English skills

Experience with social media platforms including YouTube,
, Instagram, and X

Comfortable using tools like Google Sheets, Canva, and basic video editing software

Organized, reliable, and able to work independently with minimal supervision

Some experience with podcast or influencer outreach is a big plus

Experience with paid ads is a plus but not required

Experience WITH SEO is a plus



Read Before Applying

To confirm you have read this post in full, please include the word bedrock somewhere in your application message.



Also please tell us:

Days/times you are available, converted to Central Time Zone

Your preferred hourly rate in USD

Applications that do not include these will not be considered.



To Apply

Send us a message telling us a little about yourself, your relevant experience, and why this role interests you.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: AI Filmmaker — Seedance 2.0 (OpenArt) — Fantasy-Comedy Series — Per-Project Pay, Growth to Full-Time Staff
description:
AI Filmmaker — Seedance 2.0 — Fantasy-Comedy Series — Per-Project

Pay, Growth to Full-Time



I'm producing "Mystical Mischief," an AI-generated cozy-fantasy comedy

series: 30–40 minute episodes plus vertical Shorts. This is cinematic

storytelling, not ad content. Episode One is finished; a promo campaign

and Episode Two are shot-listed and ready to produce now.



Every clip comes with a professional instruction page: the exact prompt,

the reference images, the duration, and how each clip connects to the

next. You bring the craftsmanship — generation, judgment, consistency,

and assembly.



THE WORK

- Generate 15-second clips in Seedance 2.0 on OpenArt (my account, my

  credits) from my prompt documents

- Protect consistency: character faces must not drift, props must not

  swap, clips must chain correctly (I provide the start-frame workflow)

- Judge takes like a filmmaker — reject warped faces, wrong emotion, bad

  audio; regenerate smart

- Assemble finished Shorts and episodes (Premiere Pro or CapCut), with

  synced dialogue and burned captions on Shorts

- If a scene doesn't make sense or a generation won't match the

  instructions, flag it to me — never quietly improvise



REQUIRED

- Real experience with Seedance 2.0 or equivalent text-to-video tools

  (Kling, Veo, Runway) and able to master Seedance fast

- Video editing (Premiere Pro or CapCut)

- Excellent English — you'll be judging whether comedy lands on screen

- A storyteller's eye and honest communication



BONUS: audio mixing, ElevenLabs voice generation, narrative/episodic

experience, and staying current on new AI video tools — the field moves

fast, and I'd love to hear what's rising from you first.



PAY (per finished deliverable)

- Paid trial: one Short, $12

- Shorts: $17 per finished Short (30–60 seconds — generated to spec,

  QC'd, assembled, captioned, ready for my final pass)

- Episodes: $400 per finished episode, paid in three milestones

- Generation credits are always on my account. Fixes for face drift,

  prop swaps, or broken continuity are included — that's what

  "finished" means.



We start per-project with the Shorts campaign (~10 Shorts). Do those

well and Episode Two is waiting; do that well and this becomes a

full-time hourly position as the show grows.



TO APPLY — answer everything (incomplete applications are skipped):

1. Links to your AI video generation work AND your editing work.

   Storytelling samples beat ads — if all you have is ads, show me the

   one that tells the best story.

2. What are your strongest skills, and why should I choose you?

3. Honestly: do you prefer storytelling work or commercial/ad work?

4. How do you work when nobody is checking on you?

5. Realistic turnaround time for one 30–45 second Short, generated and

   assembled?

6. Tell me about a detail you caught on a project — a continuity error,

   a bad cut, a mistimed beat — that nobody else noticed.

7. Which text-to-video tools have you used, and which new one are you

   watching right now?



HOW HIRING WORKS: I'll pick the top few applicants, and each will be

paid $12 to produce one real Short from my instructions. Whoever

delivers the best work gets the ongoing position. You get paid for the

trial either way.

title: Organic Account Video Editor
description:
Here's the full job description with the tiered pay structure, a clear path to the money, and vision talk woven in to get strong applicants excited.



Organic Account Video Editor — AI Influencer Content (TikTok / IG Reels / YouTube Shorts)

We're a fast-growing health & wellness brand scaling our organic social presence hard — and we're looking for fast, consistent short-form editors to ride the wave with us. This is a systemized, high-volume role built on a simple truth: we already know what goes viral, because we're modeling proven winning accounts. Your job is to replicate what works, at speed, with our own AI influencer twist — and get paid more the bigger you help us grow.

You won't be guessing what to make. We hand you the reference accounts. You recreate the videos, swap in our AI character, and post consistently.

The process (per video):



Pull a video from our library of viral reference accounts and reuse the exact script/structure that's already proven to work

Recreate the video closely — screenshot the reference, drop it into our AI tools with the script, and rebuild it

Replace the on-screen talent with our AI influencer (one consistent character per account)

Caption, polish, and publish



We have an automation system on the way that will make this even faster. For now it's a manual, repeatable process — so we need someone reliable who can hit volume without cutting corners.

The daily target:



3 accounts, 5 videos per account = 15 videos per day

Each account keeps one consistent AI character for brand continuity

Consistency and turnaround win here — the formula is already provided



The opportunity (read this part carefully):

Accounts running this exact system are pulling 10M+ organic views in 30 days. That's not a typo. When you're posting proven content consistently across multiple accounts, the views compound fast — and every one of those views is a potential sale flowing through your affiliate link.

This is a genuine ground-floor opportunity. Get in now, master the system while it's manual, and you'll be the go-to operator when we roll out automation and scale to dozens of accounts. The editors who show up, stay consistent, and take this seriously are going to grow with the brand — not just edit for it.

Pay structure — base + affiliate commission (real path to $1,000+/week):



Onboarding (first 30 days): $500/mo base + affiliate commission on every sale from your content

Established: Base increases once you're consistently hitting 15/day and landing your first viral videos

Top performer: Highest base tier + commission for editors driving consistent viral hits and sales

Your affiliate link is your uncapped upside. The more your videos convert, the more you earn — on top of base. Consistent editors are realistically building toward $1,000+/week in the next 30–60 days as their accounts take off.



How you get there:

Week 1–2 you learn the system and lock in your daily volume. Weeks 3–4 your accounts start gaining traction and the first videos pop. By day 30–60, with consistent output, your accounts are compounding views, your commission is climbing, and your base steps up with your results. Show up daily, follow the system, and the numbers take care of themselves.

What we're looking for:



Fast, dependable editor who can hit daily volume without dropping quality

Comfortable working from references and following a proven system

Solid with CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, plus willingness to learn our AI toolset

Sharp eye for matching pacing, captions, hooks, and sound to the original

Reliable communicator who shows up every day — this is a consistency game



How to apply:

Include (1) a link to your portfolio or 3–5 short-form videos you've edited, (2) which editing software you use, and (3) start your message with the word "REPLICATE" so we know you read this fully. Applications without a portfolio won't be considered.

title: B2B Lead Generation Specialist — AI Tools, LinkedIn & Cold Calling
description:
Coreworks AI is looking for a sharp, resourceful Business Development / Demand Generation Specialist to help us build a high-quality outbound pipeline.



Coreworks helps teams create complex business documents, reports, presentations, and workflows from data — with traceability, editability, and AI-assisted analysis. Our buyers and users include startup founders, finance leaders, customer success teams, sales leaders, quality leaders, operations leaders, and other teams that spend hours or days building complex decks, reports, scorecards, QBRs, board decks, supplier reviews, quality documents, and other data-backed business artifacts.



This is not a basic lead scraping or data entry job. We are looking for someone who can think, research, personalize, write, call, follow up, run multi-channel campaigns, and help us learn which markets respond best.



What you will do



You will work directly with the founder/team to identify, research, contact, and qualify high-quality prospects across multiple use cases.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, company websites, job posts, funding/news signals, event lists, and other research sources.

* Research companies and prospects deeply enough to write relevant, specific outreach.

* Use AI tools to speed up research, account summaries, personalization, messaging, list building, and follow-ups.

* Run multi-channel outreach across LinkedIn,
, phone calls, and follow-up campaigns.

* Write and send personalized LinkedIn messages, cold
s, warm follow-ups, and event-related outreach.

* Call prospects where appropriate to qualify interest and schedule meetings.

* Support sophisticated
 marketing campaigns for events, webinars, founder roundtables, customer conversations, and targeted outbound experiments.

* Help create and manage campaign lists, audience segments, follow-up sequences, and event invite workflows.

* Identify the right persona depending on the use case: founders, CEOs, COOs, CFOs, RevOps leaders, customer success leaders, sales leaders, quality leaders, supplier quality managers, and operations leaders.

* Track all outreach activity, replies, call notes, objections, meeting outcomes, and learnings in Attio.

* Help run and improve outbound campaigns using tools such as 
, Attio, Apollo, Clay, LinkedIn, Google Sheets, and AI tools.

* Test different outbound angles and report what is working each week.

* Help refine ICPs, messaging, objection handling, prospecting workflows, and campaign strategy.

* Book qualified meetings for Coreworks.



Who we are looking for



You should have 4–5+ years of experience in outbound sales, business development, demand generation, appointment setting, lead generation,
 marketing, or sales development for B2B companies.



You are likely a strong fit if you:



* Have experience prospecting for B2B SaaS, AI, software, consulting, data, finance, sales, operations, or enterprise tools.

* Know how to use LinkedIn for research, outreach, and follow-up.

* Have experience with multi-channel outbound: LinkedIn,
, phone calls, and follow-up sequences.

* Have some experience supporting
 campaigns, event campaigns, webinar campaigns, newsletter campaigns, or targeted B2B nurture campaigns.

* Can write clear, concise, personalized English messages.

* Are comfortable calling prospects and having a professional first conversation.

* Can understand different buyer personas and adjust messaging accordingly.

* Are comfortable using AI tools for research, personalization, list building, and message drafting.

* Are organized, reliable, and detail-oriented.

* Can work independently and show weekly progress.

* Are comfortable experimenting, measuring results, and improving the outbound process over time.



Important: this is not a fit if you only do basic data entry



We do not want someone who only copies names into a spreadsheet.



We want someone who can think like a junior growth operator:



* Why is this person a good prospect?

* What use case is relevant to them?

* What pain might they have?

* What signal suggests this company is worth contacting?

* What message would make them respond?

* Which channel should we use first: LinkedIn,
, phone, or event invite?

* What follow-up should we send based on their reply or behavior?

* What did we learn from the reply, call, or campaign result?



Example prospecting motions



You may help us prospect into segments such as:



* SaaS founders building board decks, investor updates, QBRs, pricing models, customer reports, or operational reviews.

* Customer success leaders creating QBRs, EBRs, account plans, renewal-risk reports, and post-call action workflows.

* Sales and RevOps teams building proposals, sales decks, pipeline reviews, account plans, and customer-facing reports from CRM and data.

* Quality and operations leaders creating supplier scorecards, supplier quality reviews, PPAP/FAIR packages, APQR-like reports, and other evidence-backed documents.

* Finance and operations teams creating monthly business reviews, variance reports, board materials, and executive dashboards.

* Invite-only event audiences for founder roundtables, webinars, learning calls, and targeted Coreworks demos.



Tools you may use



Experience with some of these tools is a plus:



* LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator

* Apollo

* Clay

* 

* Attio

* Google Sheets

* Notion

* ChatGPT / Claude / Perplexity

* Aircall, OpenPhone, JustCall, or similar calling tools

* Loom for quick updates or prospect research summaries



You do not need to know every tool, but you must be comfortable learning new AI, sales, CRM, and campaign tools quickly.



Success metrics



We will measure success based on:



* Quality of target accounts and prospects

* Number of relevant prospects researched

* Quality of personalization and messaging

* Number of LinkedIn,
, phone, and campaign touchpoints completed

* Positive reply rate

* Qualified meetings booked

* Event invite response rate and attendee quality

* Quality of call notes and CRM updates

* Speed of learning across ICPs, messages, and channels

* Ability to improve the outbound system over time



Working style



This is a remote role. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating clearly, and giving structured updates.



You will be expected to provide a weekly report covering:



* Prospects researched

* Outreach sent by channel

* Replies received

* Calls made

* Meetings booked

* Event invites sent and responses received

* Objections heard

* Best-performing messages

* Best-performing ICPs or segments

* Suggested improvements for next week



Requirements



* 4–5+ years of B2B sales development, lead generation, outbound, appointment setting, demand generation, or B2B
 campaign experience.

* Strong written English.

* Comfortable speaking English on calls.

* Experience with LinkedIn prospecting.

* Experience with cold
, outbound sequences, or B2B campaign follow-up.

* Some experience with event, webinar, newsletter, or nurture campaign execution.

* Comfortable using AI tools for research and personalization.

* Organized and process-oriented.

* Able to work with U.S. time zone overlap.



Compensation



Competitive monthly base pay plus performance-based bonus for qualified meetings booked and accepted.



Please apply only if you have real outbound, demand generation, or B2B campaign experience and can show examples of previous prospecting, messaging, tools used, campaigns supported, and results.

title: Senior Executive Assistant / Client Operations - US IT Services Firm (MSP experience preferred)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION (paste below into description box):



ABOUT US



We are an established, growing US-based managed IT services provider (MSP) serving businesses in regulated industries. Small team, high standards, long-term client relationships. This role works directly with the owner as his right hand.



WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT



This is not a task-list VA position. The owner will hand you entire workstreams in working sessions. For example: "own the renewal process for all of our client agreements" or "roll out updated employment agreements to our staff." Your job is to ask sharp questions, build the process, execute to 80-90% completion, and return with focused, decision-ready questions: "here is my thinking, do you want direction A or direction B?"



You will draft client-facing communication that requires care and nuance, keep billing and renewal cycles running on time, handle procurement and vendor follow-ups, and close every loop without being reminded.



You will also work alongside serious AI tooling (Claude) every day. No prior AI experience is required, but you must be the kind of person who picks up new tools quickly and gets excited about what they can do. Here, AI handles much of the drafting and computation; your judgment directs it. One sharp person in this role does the work of three.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Client agreement renewals: the calendar, updated agreements, outreach, and follow-through (the owner handles only the largest strategic conversations)

- Client operations communication: order updates, pricing-change notes, and day-to-day client
s that need nuance and warmth

- Billing administration: monthly license invoicing, catching unbilled work, keeping invoices aligned with agreements

- Procurement: hardware quotes and orders, vendor follow-ups, license purchasing

- Internal projects: for example, rolling out NDAs and updated employment agreements via DocuSign, from research to signed

- Owner support: calendar, travel, payment deadlines, the details that keep a business running smoothly



YOU ARE PROBABLY A FIT IF



- You have 4+ years as an EA, operations coordinator, service coordinator, or account manager

- You have MSP or IT services experience (strongly preferred); you know what a PSA is, and ConnectWise, Autotask, or HaloPSA experience is a significant plus

- Your written English is excellent; you can take three tangled facts and turn them into one clear, warm, professional client note

- You have BUILT processes, not just followed them, and can tell us about one

- You flag things that look wrong instead of guessing

- You are comfortable being handed ambiguity and coming back with a plan

- You are excited about AI and learn new tools quickly

- You have reliable power and internet with a tested backup plan (we will ask)

- You can overlap US Mountain Time mornings by at least 4 hours (roughly 9pm-1am PH time, negotiable)



COMPENSATION AND SETUP



- $1,300-$1,700/month USD full-time, depending on experience, deliberately above typical market, because we are hiring judgment, not just hands

- Compensation review at 90 days, with real raise potential for demonstrated ownership

- Long-term role with growing responsibility; we are hiring for years, not months

- 13th month honored; paid PH holidays negotiable

- Shortlisted candidates complete a PAID work sample (about 2.5 hours, $40); we respect your time



HOW TO APPLY



Put the word COMPASS as the first word of your application subject line. Applications without it will not be read. This is our attention-to-detail filter; this role lives and dies on details.



Send a short note about yourself (not a template, we can tell) plus your CV, and complete these four items:



1. Describe a process you built from scratch at a previous job. What was messy before, and what did you create?



2. Tell us about a billing, order, or scheduling discrepancy you caught that nobody asked you to look for. What happened?



3. Scenario: a client's hardware order changed. Prices rose industry-wide since the original quote. The first machine chosen was somewhat over-spec for their needs. The replacement now being quoted is both a better fit AND a better machine, at a strong price given the market. Write the 3-6 sentence
 to the client.



4. Include a short video (60-90 seconds, Loom or similar). No script, no slides, just talk: pick the most complex thing you manage in your current or most recent role, and explain it to us the way you would to a new colleague on their first day. We want to hear how you communicate when you have not rehearsed.

title: Cold Calling Team Lead for AI Receptionist Company — HVAC Outreach
description:
We are looking for an experienced Cold Calling Team Lead to help us build and manage a small outbound calling team for CallBrixa.



CallBrixa is an AI receptionist service for HVAC companies in the United States. Our AI helps HVAC businesses answer missed calls, qualify leads, collect customer details, identify urgent HVAC situations, and send short call summaries to the business owner.



This is not just a regular cold calling position. We need someone who can make calls personally, manage other callers, help hire new callers, review reports, improve scripts, train the team, and give honest feedback.



At the beginning, you will manage yourself and 2 cold callers. As the team grows, you may help us hire and manage more callers.



ABOUT CALLBRIXA



CallBrixa helps HVAC companies avoid losing customers from missed calls.



Many HVAC business owners miss customer calls when they are busy, driving, working on a job, closed, or receiving calls after hours. CallBrixa answers those calls with an AI receptionist.



The AI can:

- Answer calls 24/7

- Ask what service the customer needs

- Collect the customer’s name, phone number, address, issue details, and urgency

- Identify urgent HVAC situations such as no heating, no cooling, or emergency repairs

- Send a short call summary to the business owner

- Give business owners a demo number they can call to test how the AI receptionist works



We are also adding more features soon, including Google Calendar scheduling. This will allow the AI assistant to check available appointment times, suggest visit times to the customer, and book the appointment if the customer agrees.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Cold Calling



- Call HVAC businesses in the United States

- Speak with owners or managers

- Explain CallBrixa in a simple and professional way

- Ask if they miss calls when they are busy, driving, on a job, closed, or after hours

- Offer them an easy way to test the AI receptionist by calling our demo number

- Follow the call script, but also improve it based on real conversations

- Record every call result in the reporting file



2. Team Management



- Manage 2 cold callers at the beginning

- Check their daily reports

- Make sure they are calling properly

- Review their performance

- Help them improve their calls

- Help them understand the script and offer

- Make sure they record results correctly



3. Hiring and Training

mbers

title: Full Cycle Bookkeeper - Experienced 5 yr +
description:
Read this entire posting before applying. If you skip to the apply button, you will be rejected automatically.

I am done wasting time and money on VAs who overpromise and underdeliver. This posting is intentionally blunt so only qualified, serious candidates apply. If you do not meet ALL of the requirements below, do not apply — you will not be considered, and applications that ignore this will be deleted without a response.

Non-Negotiable Requirements — ALL of these are deal-breakers if not met:



1 -Speak and write English clearly. If you have a thick accent or are not fluent in written and spoken English, do not apply. This is an immediate disqualifier.

2 - Be an actual, hands-on expert in bookkeeping, payroll, and HR administration. I use QuickBooks Online, Cin7 Core for inventory/COGS, MakersHub for AP, and Paylocity for payroll. If you claim experience with these tools and then have to Google how to do basic tasks once hired, this is an immediate disqualifier. You will be tested before hire — see below.

3 - Explain things simply. I am not an accountant. If I ask you a question and you can't break it down in plain language I understand right away, do not apply. I need someone who translates the technical into the simple, not someone who talks over my head.

4 - Follow instructions exactly. I have had VAs guess at what I wanted, get "creative," do work I never asked for, and then expect to be paid for it. This happens ONCE and we're done. I am open to your suggestions on better ways to do things — but only with my approval before you act. Suggest, don't assume.

5 - Do not pad your hours. I know roughly how long tasks take, and I am generous about it. If I see 15-minute tasks billed as multi-hour tasks, my generosity disappears immediately and so does the job.

6 - Show up on time, every time. I understand life happens — tell me in advance and I will be understanding. Chronic lateness or last-minute excuses (storms, internet outages, etc., without advance notice) will end this immediately. One strike.

7 - We pay via Payoneer ONLY. No exceptions. If you don't have a Payoneer account or can't set one up, do not apply. This is nonnegotiable — no PayPal, no Wise, no bank transfer, no other method.

8 - We track time using Timeproof. Mandatory, no exceptions. If you are not willing to use Timeproof for every hour billed, do not apply. This is not up for discussion.

9 - Meetings are professional — no children visible or audible on camera. These are leadership meetings. My team does not bring kids into the office, and I expect the same from you. Have children asleep, at school, or with another caregiver during our scheduled meeting times. If a child is on camera or heard in the background, the meeting will end.

10 - If I call you during paid hours, you answer. Period. No exceptions, no "I saw it but was busy." If you're on the clock, you're reachable.



What You'll Be Doing:



Full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online — transaction coding, reconciliations, AP/AR

Inventory and COGS tracking and reconciliation in Cin7 Core

Vendor bill capture, approval routing, and payment processing through MakersHub or QBO

Payroll support and coordination through Paylocity

HR administrative support — onboarding documentation, recordkeeping, basic compliance tasks

Monthly financial reporting to ownership



Application Instructions — Read Carefully:



To prove you read this far, start your application with the word LEDGER in the subject line. Applications without it will not be opened.

Confirm in your application that you have a Payoneer account, are willing to use Timeproof for every hour worked, can keep meetings child-free, and will answer calls during paid hours. If you don't confirm all four, your application will be skipped.

Include your specific hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online, Cin7 Core, MakersHub, and Paylocity — not "familiar with," actual experience.

Include your available start date and your hourly rate expectation.

Be prepared to complete a short paid skills test before any offer is made.



This is a long-term, part-time position for the right person, with room to grow. If you meet every requirement above and can prove it, I want to hear from you. If you don't, please save us both the time.

title: Video Editor Wanted — Cinematic Real Estate Reels (9:16)
description:
ArcaTech | Las Vegas, NV | 



About Us



ArcaTech creates cinematic video home tours and social media content for real estate agents in Las Vegas. We shoot high-end walkthroughs and turn them into scroll-stopping content that helps agents sell homes faster. We're looking for an editor who can match that same level of polish in short-form vertical video.



What You'll Do



We shoot on a Sony A7SIII in 16:9. You'll take that raw footage and turn it into 9:16 reels built for Instagram and TikTok — fast, cinematic, and built to hold attention from the first frame.



Specifically, you'll:





Reframe and re-edit 16:9 footage into clean, dynamic 9:16 vertical cuts

Build real estate montages with smooth, intentional room-to-room transitions that make the flow of a home feel natural and immersive

Execute day-to-night transitions and timelapses that feel seamless, not gimmicky

Create "assemble/disassemble" effects — homes that build themselves piece by piece or fold away — as a signature visual style

Color grade and stabilize footage to elevate shots that weren't perfectly lit or framed on-site

Sync cuts to trending audio and music where it fits, without losing the cinematic feel

Deliver polished, ready-to-post final files on a reliable turnaround





What We're Looking For





A strong portfolio of vertical (9:16) real estate or property content — this is non-negotiable, please include links or files

Real experience with home/interior transition editing and understanding of spatial flow through a property

Comfort with day-to-night grading and timelapse construction

Experience building "build/disassemble" or similar stylized transition effects (Premiere, After Effects, or similar)

An eye for salvaging imperfect footage — shaky handheld, inconsistent lighting, awkward angles — and still producing a clean final product

Fast, clear communication and reliable delivery timelines

Familiarity with real estate marketing content is a strong plus





Tools We Use



Sony A7SIII footage delivered raw. You're welcome to use your preferred editing suite (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, etc.) as long as the output quality speaks for itself.



To Apply



Send us:





A link to your reel portfolio (vertical format preferred)

2-3 examples of real estate or property-based edits, if available

Your typical turnaround time per reel and your rate (per project or per reel)

You will also be required to produce a sample reel using our footage before chosen for full time work.

title: Creative Designer
description:
Job Title: Creative Designer (Full-time)

Employment Type: Freelance/Consultant

Work Set-up: Remote

Location: Philippines



Job Summary:

We are looking for a talented and innovative Creative Designer to join our dynamic team. As a Creative Designer, you will play a crucial role in developing visually compelling and engaging content. You will collaborate with the marketing, acquisition & VIP teams to create graphics that enhance the overall user experience and contribute to the success of our brands.



Responsibilities:

1. Visual & UI/UX Design

- Digital Asset Creation: Design cohesive website elements, high-end promotional banners, and social media graphics that align with brand guidelines.

- Responsive Optimization: Adapt and optimize layouts for different screen sizes, devices, and resolutions to ensure seamless display.

- Trend Integration: Research industry trends to continuously bring innovative, modern design concepts to the platforms.



2. Brand, Image Editing & Collaboration

- Brand Consistency: Maintain and update design asset libraries across all channels to reinforce a consistent brand identity.

- Image Optimization: Edit, crop, and optimize imagery for the web to guarantee pixel-perfect quality and fast page loading times.

- Cross-Functional Teamwork: Work hand-in-hand with internal teams to ensure flawless execution and integration of design concepts.



3. Quality Assurance & UI/UX Support

- Pixel-Perfect QA: Conduct thorough checks on all deliverables to ensure complete accuracy, consistency, and strict adherence to brand guidelines.

- Cross-Device Testing: Test interfaces across multiple browsers, devices, and screen sizes to identify and fix usability flaws or layout inconsistencies.

- Dev & Client Alignment: Partner closely with developers, marketing teams, and third-party clients to ensure seamless asset integration and maintain design integrity.

- Design Systems & Docs: Assist in building and maintaining design documentation, style guides, and reusable design system components.

- Team Collaboration: Share constructive feedback and guidance with team members to help maintain a high standard of design excellence.



Requirements:

-Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, Graphic Design, Visual Arts, UI/UX Design, or any related field, or relevant professional certifications (e.g., UI/UX bootcamps, Google UX Design Certificate, etc.), or equivalent professional experience.

- Minimum of 1 year of proven professional experience as a Graphic/Creative Designer, Illustrator, or UI/UX Designer, preferably within fast-paced digital industries (e.g., e-commerce, online gaming, or digital agencies).

- Prior experience working with European clients or international brands, with a solid understanding of European design sensibilities, aesthetics, and localized visual trends.

- Highly AI-literate: Hands-on experience utilizing AI generation platforms (such as LeonardoAI, or Adobe Firefly) to optimize creative workflows, brainstorm concepts, and significantly speed up asset production times.

- Knowledgeable in UI/UX design, with a strong command of user interface principles, responsive layouts, design systems, and user-centric design methodologies.

- Advanced proficiency in standard graphic design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).

- Strong portfolio showcasing a variety of design work, with an emphasis on digital and online platforms.

- Understanding of user interface design principles and user experience concepts.

- Ability to work under tight deadlines and adapt to a fast-paced environment.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

title: Facebook Reel Editor — UK Talent Content
description:
The Role

We're looking for a fast, reliable video editor to join a small team producing monetised
 content for high-profile UK reality TV talent. This is a freelance, remote role with consistent weekly volume and the potential to scale as we onboard additional talent pages.

You'll be cutting raw footage — to-camera clips, voice notes, behind-the-scenes material, archive content — into 1–3 minute
 reels optimised for watch-time, comments and shares as well as monetisation. The creative direction, hooks, and structures will be provided to you in detailed build packages. Your job is to execute them quickly and cleanly. Your creative direction and adjustments to ensure virality are esential.



What You'll Be Editing

All content is for
 pages with a predominantly female UK and Australian audience aged 30–40. These are women who are mums, who follow reality TV, who engage with honest parenting content, relationship real talk, body image, postpartum life, and unfiltered personal storytelling. Understanding this audience is essential — the edit style, pacing, music choices, and text overlays all need to feel right for this demographic. Nothing overly polished or influencer-glossy. Nothing that feels like it was made for a 22-year-old on TikTok.



The content that performs best on these pages is raw, emotionally honest, and real. Think: a new mum talking candidly about her c-section recovery, not a wellness brand doing a transition reel. The editing should enhance the authenticity, not cover it up.



Mothers with young children are particularly encouraged to apply. Much of the content centres on the reality of early motherhood — breastfeeding struggles, postpartum recovery, sleep deprivation, the emotional rollercoaster of having a newborn — and an editor who has lived that experience will instinctively understand where the emotional beats land in a way that's very difficult to brief for.



Deliverables

•  1–3 minute
 reels, edited from raw footage and/or archive clips

•  Each reel follows a provided build package: timestamped structure, hook, voiceover notes, on-screen text, shot-by-shot timeline

•  Clean first frames (no black screens, no mid-sentence starts — the thumbnail is the first frame)

•  Music/sound selection appropriate for UK mum audience — emotionally resonant, not trend-chasing

•  Exported in
-optimised format (9:16 or 4:5 depending on content type, high resolution)

•  Estimated volume: 10–15 reels per week across one page initially, scaling to multiple pages





What We Need From You

•  Strong understanding of the UK market and UK cultural references — Geordie Shore, ITV reality, UK parenting culture, British humour and tone. If you don't know what a Greggs sausage roll is, this probably isn't the right fit.

•  Experience editing content for women and/or mums — you understand pacing that holds attention for this demographic, not just Gen Z scroll speed

•  An instinct for emotional storytelling — knowing where to cut, where to let a moment breathe, where to drop in text that lands

•  Fast turnaround — we work in weekly batches and need reliability above all

•  Comfortable working from detailed briefs and build packages rather than freestyling — the creative direction is set, you're executing it

•  Basic understanding of
 monetisation and watch-time mechanics (we'll brief you fully, but awareness helps)

•  Responsive communication, ideally on WhatsApp or Slack

•  Familiarity with the talent we work with is a genuine bonus — if you already follow or watch them, you'll have a natural feel for the content and the audience





What You Don't Need

•  You don't need to be UK-based, but you do need to understand the UK audience and cultural context

•  You don't need to write captions, titles, or thumbnails — those are handled separately

•  You don't need high-end motion graphics skills — this is about authentic, emotionally engaging cuts, not flashy production





Terms

•  Freelance / contract basis

•  Paid per reel or monthly retainer depending on volume (discuss at application) potential for full time role.

•  Trial period: 5 reels in the first week to assess quality, speed, and reliability

•  Potential to scale significantly as additional talent pages come online



To Apply

Send a short message with:

•  2–3 examples of reels or short-form videos you've edited (ideally for a female/mum audience or UK talent — but any strong emotional storytelling work is relevant)

•  Your typical turnaround time for a 2–3 minute reel from provided footage (or that which you source from Instagram/TT)•  Your rate (per reel or monthly)

•  A one-line summary of why you'd be a good fit for this specific audience

•  Name a piece of UK reality TV content you've watched or followed recently — this helps us gauge your familiarity with the market



No agencies. No generic applications. If your portfolio is all corporate explainers and product ads, this isn't the role.

title: Mid-Senior PHP/Laravel Developer
description:
About KomX



Kommunale Exzellenz (KomX) is an early-stage SaaS platform that digitizes the organizational structure and internal processes of German municipal administrations. Tasks are the cornerstone — rights, workflows, and responsibilities flow from organizational positions and the tasks attached to them, not from individual user identities. We are currently working with one development-partner municipality and preparing for broader rollout.



We are hiring our first engineering hire: a senior PHP/Laravel developer to work alongside founder Jens Santjer on a feature-rich, working-but-raw codebase originally built with AI assistance.



Responsibilities



-Build and maintain the automated test suite. Take a feature-rich codebase from near-zero coverage to a real regression safety net, one critical flow at a time. This is core to the role and the standing weekly discipline.

-Harden security and GDPR compliance. Work through a prioritized audit backlog and security-review every new feature before it ships.

-Establish release engineering. Introduce self-hosted version control, CI, and a staging pipeline that ends in a verified, scripted release package.

-Own pre-production verification. Run the staging tier, reproduce reported issues locally from sanitized descriptions, and dry-run every migration against a populated test tenant before it reaches production.

-Review AI-generated code. Act as the human quality gate for code produced with AI assistance. -Honest pushback is the explicit expectation — “looks fine to me” without verification is the one output this role must never produce.

-Manage technical debt and consistency. Consolidate duplicated logic, keep documentation true, and enforce the codebase’s established patterns.



Qualifications

You have:

-3+ years professional PHP, with strong recent Laravel 11 or 12 experience

-PostgreSQL fluency — JSON operators, enums, indexes, query plans

-Experience with multi-tenant Laravel applications (stancl/tenancy v3 multi-database mode hands-on is a plus; we’ll ramp you on the specifics)

-Working knowledge of spatie/laravel-permission

-Confidence with Blade templating and vanilla JavaScript (no SPA framework, no Livewire, no Inertia)

-GDPR fundamentals — data minimization, retention, deletion rights (Art. 15/17/20)

-Git proficiency

-PHPUnit experience, including factories and multi-tenant test bootstrapping

-AI tool fluency (Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent), with the discipline to override the AI when it’s wrong



You are:

-Fluent in English, written and spoken

-Comfortable with mostly async work plus one daily sync during overlap hours

-Energized by bringing engineering discipline to a raw codebase

-Willing to help shape engineering processes and tooling, not just write code

-Willing to tell the founder “the AI got this wrong, here’s why”



How We Work:

-Mostly async, one daily sync. You control your working rhythm. One focused daily sync during overlap hours plus a written daily update in our shared workspace.

-Overlap windows. PH 12:00–2:00 PM (Germany 6:00–8:00 AM) or PH 10:00 PM onwards (Germany 4:00 PM onwards), plus full weekends. You only need one of these per day for the sync — not your whole working day.



Engagement and Compensation:

-Full-time freelance engagement, approximately 40 hours per week, with KomX as your primary engagement. You can take on other clients as long as they don’t compete for your availability during our overlap windows or conflict with delivery commitments. Please disclose any existing engagements during the interview process.



-Compensation is negotiated based on experience and fit — share your monthly rate expectation in your application.



-30-day notice either side, at any point in the engagement.



How to Apply:

Please include:

-A brief note on why this role interests you

-Your CV or LinkedIn profile

-2–3 examples of past work

-Your monthly rate expectation

-Earliest possible start date

Send to 
 read every application personally.

title: Sales, Customer Relationship & Executive Support Specialist (Remote)

CoolHed is an Australian company delivering innovative thermoregulation and wellness solutions across workplace safety, corporate wellness, athletic recovery, education, and healthcare. You will play a key role in following up on our existing pipeline of qualified leads, nurturing relationships, supporting new business opportunities, and ensuring our customers receive exceptional service.

Sales & Lead Management

Follow up on our existing qualified leads and convert opportunities into customers and strategic partnerships.

Respond to inbound enquiries and qualify new prospects.

Conduct outbound outreach to expand our pipeline across Australia and the United States.

Schedule meetings, product demonstrations, and follow-up calls.

Prepare quotes, proposals, and sales documentation.

Maintain an accurate CRM and ensure all customer interactions are recorded.

Consistently nurture leads through every stage of the sales process.

Assist customers with product enquiries, onboarding, orders, and post-sale support.

Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer issues promptly.

Identify opportunities for repeat business, referrals, and account growth.

Executive Support (CEO & COO)

Support the CEO and COO with calendar management, scheduling, and meeting coordination.

Prepare reports, presentations, and business documents.

Organize contracts, customer records, and company files.

Coordinate conference and event follow-up activities.

Assist with travel arrangements, research, and special projects as required.

Requirements

Experience in B2B sales, customer success, account management, or business development.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar.

Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.

Professional, proactive, and self-motivated.

Experience supporting founders or senior executives.

Experience working with Australian or U.S. clients.

Background in healthcare, wellness, workplace safety, medical devices, or startups.

Existing leads are actively followed up and progressing through the sales pipeline.

Consistent support provided to the CEO and COO, improving operational efficiency.

Your availability and time zone.

title: Remote Senior Nonprofit Bookkeeper
description:
About Us

We are a USA-based accounting and advisory firm dedicated exclusively to serving nonprofit organizations and mental health practices. We manage the complete accounting cycle for a portfolio of nonprofit clients simultaneously, delivering accurate, timely, and audit-ready financial records. Our clients trust us with the financial foundation of their missions. Every tea
mber we bring on is expected to perform at a professional level from day one, follow our documented systems, and take genuine ownership of their client portfolio.



About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper to join our team. In this role, you will oversee comprehensive bookkeeping functions, ensuring accuracy and compliance across all financial records for a portfolio of nonprofit clients. You will work within our established systems and be held to firm-wide standards of accuracy and deadlines from day one.



This is not an entry-level role. You are expected to arrive with a fully developed competency in nonprofit accounting and the professional judgment to apply it independently across multiple clients in a remote environment.



Responsibilities

- Record and classify all transactions on an accrual basis with proper account coding, class tracking, and fund designation.

- Manage and maintain the general ledger in accordance with GAAP.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable: enter vendor bills, process payments, record invoices, and apply receipts accurately.

- Prepare and post all month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepaid amortization, depreciation, and deferred revenue schedules.

- Conduct balance sheet reconciliation and review financial statements for discrepancies or errors.

- Record payroll allocation entries across cost centers, grants, and functional expense categories.

- Track restricted grants, donor contributions, and program expenses in compliance with nonprofit accounting standards.

- Produce and deliver month-end financial statements for management review.

- Support the Form 990 and audit preparation process by maintaining clean, organized records and preparing schedules as requested.

- Maintain meticulous records of journal entries, account analyses, and audit documentation to ensure audit readiness.

- Utilize accounting software, including QuickBooks Online and Xero, to manage bookkeeping operations.

- Identify opportunities to automate financial processes and increase efficiency.

- Deliver clear, accurate financial reports for internal review, client communication, and external audits.



Qualifications

 - Minimum 5 years of nonprofit accounting experience with demonstrated ability to apply accrual accounting, fund accounting, net asset classifications under ASU
, grant tracking, and functional expense allocation independently and without supervision.

 - Demonstrated ability to apply ASC 606 and ASC 842 standards, specifically managing revenue recognition based on grant documents, funder restrictions, and milestones.

- Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously in an outsourced accounting firm or agency setting.

- Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO), Xero, Sage, and other financial management tools.

- Advanced proficiency in project and work management tools such as Asana, Gmail, Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, 
, Ramp, and similar platforms.

- Deep understanding of GAAP, double-entry bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, and general ledger reconciliation.

- Familiarity with governmental accounting practices and tax experience is highly desirable.

- Excellent knowledge of financial concepts, including account analysis, account reconciliation, debits and credits, journal entries, and balance sheet management.

- Ability to context-shift between multiple clients and thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment.

- Strong attention to detail and analytical skills to interpret complex financial data accurately.

- Effective written communication skills for financial reporting and client correspondence.

- High integrity, accountability, and respect for client confidentiality.

- Minimum 12 consecutive months of fully remote, self-directed work with independent deadline management.

- Problem-solving mentality with a proactive approach to process improvement and continuous learning.



Schedule and Compensation

- Commit to working a minimum of15 hours per week, with required availability from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM EST (8:00 PM to 3:00 AM PHT). 

- Hours are expected to increase to full-time as performance benchmarks are met and the client portfolio grows.



To Apply: To be considered for this position, your application must include the following, submitted together in a single
:

 - Your resume

 - A brief message describing your experience with nonprofit fund accounting and at least one outsourced or multi-client accounting environment you have supported

- The answer to the following question, included at the top of your message: "What is the net asset classification framework introduced under ASU
, and how does it differ from the previous two-category model?"

 - If you qualify for the next phase, you will be required to complete an accounting test and pass it with a 90% rate.



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be reviewed and will be automatically rejected.

title: QA Annotator – AI Voice Call Review (Healthtech, ~5–10 hrs/month)
description:
DocMaps is a Canadian healthtech startup helping patients find family doctors. Our AI voice agent calls medical clinics every month to verify appointment availability. Your annotations directly train that agent – and the data it publishes goes to health system clients and the public. This is a small role with high responsibility: accuracy is everything.



**The work**



Each monthly refresh cycle, you'll log into our admin tool and, for each call:

1. Listen to the call audio

2. Read the transcript

3. Check the data flags and correct any errors

4. Choose the correct annotation and correct action



Edge cases get escalated to me (the founder) with short written notes – no live meetings, fully async.



**You're a fit if**

- Excellent English comprehension, especially phone audio with accents and background noise

- Detail-obsessed – you catch the difference between "not accepting patients" and "waitlist only," and you never guess when unsure

- Trustworthy and consistent – this is long-term, low-hours work where reliability matters more than speed

- Healthcare, BPO, or QA experience is a plus, not required



**Logistics**

- ~5–10 hours/month, concentrated over a few days each refresh cycle (first month will be heavier – full data refresh)

- Fully remote, flexible hours, no timezone overlap required

- $7 USD/hr, paid monthly – modest hours, but stable ongoing work with a growing company

- Confidentiality agreement required (healthcare-adjacent data)

- Shortlisted candidates will complete a short **paid** trial batch of real calls before final hiring



**HOW TO APPLY – read carefully**



Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word **MAPLE**.



2. Answer this scenario in 2–4 sentences:



*You're reviewing a call. The clinic receptionist says: "We're not taking new patients right now… well, Dr. Reyes might open her list again in September, but nothing's confirmed. You could call back then." The data flag on this record currently says "Accepting new patients."*



**What annotation would you choose, what would you do with the data flag, and why?**



3. Briefly tell me about any QA, transcription, healthcare, or detail-heavy work you've done (2–3 sentences).



There is no single right answer to the scenario – I'm evaluating how you reason and communicate, not whether you guess correctly.

title: Senior Product Fulfillment & Supplier Negotiation Specialist
description:
We are a fast-growing ecommerce store in the lighting and home decor space. We sell pendant lights, chandeliers, wall lights, ceiling fans, outdoor lighting, and decor products.



We are looking for an extremely detail-oriented Senior Product Fulfillment Specialist who can manage complex customer orders, communicate with multiple suppliers, negotiate the best price, verify that every order is correct, review QC photos/videos, and track every step in a spreadsheet.



This is not a simple “place orders” role. We need someone who can think, compare, question suppliers, catch mistakes before they happen, and protect the profit margin of the business.



Main Responsibilities



You will be responsible for managing product fulfillment from order confirmation through to delivery.



Your tasks will include:



-Review each customer order carefully before fulfillment.

-Confirm the correct product, size, color, finish, voltage, quantity, and variant.

-Contact up to 3 suppliers for pricing, availability, production time, shipping cost, and QC requirements.

-Negotiate with suppliers to get the best possible price for the business.

-Compare supplier quotes in a spreadsheet before choosing the best option.

-Confirm that the supplier understands the exact order requirements before production/shipping.

-Request and review QC photos/videos before dispatch.

-Check for visible defects, wrong colors, incorrect dimensions, missing parts, poor packaging, or anything that could cause a customer complaint.

-Track every order in a detailed spreadsheet with supplier, cost, status, tracking number, ETA, QC status, notes, and issues.

-Follow up with suppliers daily when needed.

-Escalate problems quickly instead of waiting until they become bigger issues.

-Look for ways to reduce costs, prevent mistakes, and improve our fulfillment process.



This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who



-Has experience managing ecommerce orders at scale.

-Has worked with multiple suppliers, agents, factories, or sourcing teams.

-Is confident negotiating price and asking suppliers difficult questions.

-Is extremely vigilant with details.

-Is comfortable working inside spreadsheets every day.

-Can handle complex orders with multiple variants, custom requirements, and supplier options.

-Understands that one small mistake can cost the business hundreds or thousands of dollars.

-Takes ownership and does not need to be constantly reminded.



Requirements



You must have:



-Proven experience in ecommerce fulfillment, procurement, sourcing, dropshipping operations, or supplier management.

-Experience handling complex product orders, not just simple one-click fulfillment.

-Experience working with suppliers, factories, agents, or manufacturers.

-Strong spreadsheet skills using Google Sheets or Excel.

-Excellent written English.

-Extremely strong communication skills 

-Very strong attention to detail.

-Reporting skills once per week 

-Ability to compare quotes, costs, shipping fees, and lead times.

-Ability to negotiate professionally with suppliers.

-Ability to follow SOPs while also thinking independently.

-Stable internet connection and reliable availability.



Experience in lighting, furniture, home decor, construction products, or high-ticket ecommerce is a major advantage.



Proof of Experience Required



In your application, please include:



-The previous companies or stores you have worked for.

-The type of products you fulfilled or sourced.

-Expected Salary 

-The average number of orders you handled per week or per month.

-Whether you worked with suppliers, factories, agents, or 3PLs.

-An example of a complex fulfillment problem you solved.

-An example of a time you saved money for a business by negotiating or comparing suppliers.

-Your experience with Google Sheets or Excel.

-Any screenshots, templates, SOPs, reports, or trackers you have created, with private information removed.





Applications without proof of relevant experience will not be considered.





Application Test Question



A customer orders 4 brass pendant lights for $2,000.



You receive these supplier options:



Supplier A: $160 per light, $280 shipping, ships in 4 days. However, the brass finish looks slightly different in their photos.



Supplier B: $190 per light, $220 shipping, ships in 10 days. They confirm the exact finish, correct size, correct voltage, and will send QC photos before shipping.



Supplier C: $145 per light, $330 shipping, ships tomorrow. However, the size is 5cm smaller than our product page and they cannot provide QC photos.



Which supplier would you choose and why?



In your answer, please include:



The total cost of each supplier.

The risks you see with each option.

The questions you would ask before placing the order.

The QC photos or proof you would request.

What details you would track in the spreadsheet.

An example of a similar situation you have handled before.



We are looking for someone who protects profit margin, catches mistakes, and does not simply choose the cheapest supplier.



RESPONSES ARE ALL AI PLAGIARISM-CHECKED. AI RESPONSES WILL BE FLAGGED AND APPLICATION WILL BE DELETED. 



Important Traits We Are Looking For:

Detail-obsessed

Honest

Organised

Strong negotiator

Good with spreadsheets

Calm under pressure

Able to catch mistakes early

Comfortable asking suppliers direct questions

Protective of business margins

Reliable with daily follow-up

Tools You May Use

Google Sheets

Gmail

Shopify

Supplier portals

WhatsApp / WeChat /

Tracking websites

Internal SOPs and order trackers



Experience with Shopify is REQUIRED 



Working Hours



This is a remote role. We are looking for someone who can work consistently and provide daily updates. 40 hours minimum per week. 



Please include your preferred working hours and time zone in your application.



How to Apply



To apply, please send:



A short introduction about your experience.

Your previous fulfillment, sourcing, or supplier management roles.

The scale of orders you have handled.

Your answer to the application test question above.

Examples of spreadsheets, trackers, SOPs, or fulfillment systems you have used or created.

Your expected monthly salary.

Your internet speed and availability.

We're looking for a highly analytical Meta Ads specialist, part-time (20 hrs/week), to launch, optimise, and aggressively scale paid traffic into this system.



CRUCIAL: MUST READ BEFORE APPLYING



You will NOT edit videos, write copy, or design. We film 100% of creative ourselves. Your job is account management, data synthesis, and flawless tracking execution that integrates with our internal attribution database from the first dollar.



If you only boost posts or run untracked e-com setups, **DO NOT APPLY.**



If you've never scaled a personal/creator brand into a business (not e-com, not dropshipping), **DO NOT APPLY.**



OUR 6-STAGE ATTRIBUTION ARCHITECTURE (you must integrate with it):



1. Granular traffic in: you structure ads so every creative variant and hook carries a hyper-specific source tag (`src=ad_ig_studywithjed_campaign1_creativeB_hook3`)

2. Funnel A/B testing: you split-test Path A (traffic ? AI DM closer) vs Path B (traffic ? direct landing page) for the same creatives, to find the most profitable journey

3. GHL integration: your src parameter passes into GoHighLevel to trigger CloseBot AI responses

4. Stripe matching: CloseBot injects the source tag into dynamic links; our dev maps it onto Stripe payment metadata

5. Closed loop: successful payments fire webhooks pushing "PAID" back to GHL — real close % per ad asset

6. Custom dashboard: our dev builds an internal app pulling Meta spend + live Stripe/Supabase revenue to compute true CAC per individual ad



ADVANCED META ARCHITECTURE: REQUIRED EXPERTISE



- Advantage+ (ASC): set up, optimise, and feed creative into Meta's Advantage+ framework, balancing existing-customer vs cold-traffic split to scale personal-brand attention efficiently.

- Broad vs granular targeting: leverage completely open, zero-interest broad targeting to let Meta's AI find winners off the creative/hook, alongside structured interest-stack tests (students, academics, productivity/study niches, parents as well). You know when each wins.

- Lookalike strategy: build high-intent Custom Audiences from our GHL + Stripe data (paid trials, high-engagement DM tracks, 50%+ video retention) and scale horizontally via tiered Lookalikes (1%, 2-5%, etc.).

- CBO vs ABO mastery: know exactly when to use Campaign Budget Optimisation (CBO) for scaling proven pipelines vs Ad Set Budget Optimisation (ABO) for strict, controlled creative-testing phases.

- Meta CAPI + UTM/parameter mastery: dynamic placeholders, custom naming conventions, per-creative-hook parameters, no data leakage.



DATA STRATEGY (we start at $50/day):



We scale heavily once metrics prove out, but we start lean. Your strategy: capture per-ad granularity from day one, but make early optimisation calls on high-volume metrics (CTR, cost-per-DM, path-level performance) until spend scales to support reliable per-ad conversion data. If you'd optimise off 3 conversions, you're wrong for this.



RESPONSIBILITIES:



- Set up, structure, maintain Meta campaigns (IG + FB), both accounts (beginning with personal brand account only)

- Implement strict granular URL parameters down to the individual creative hook

- Execute rigorous path-level A/B testing (DM funnel vs direct)

- Read our live internal admin panel, optimise budgets to true CAC targets, not vanity front-end metrics

- Give me specific, data-backed feedback on what hooks/angles/concepts to film next



REQUIREMENTS:



- Proven Meta Ads Manager track record with documented case studies + references

- Experience scaling a SaaS business AND/OR a personal/creator brand into a business via paid (not just e-com)

- Mastery of URL parameters, naming conventions, dynamic placeholders, Meta CAPI

- Experience feeding ads into GoHighLevel / ManyChat / similar DM automation

- Advantage+, Broad vs interest targeting, Lookalikes, CBO/ABO

- Engineering-style mindset: attribution, statistical significance, data leakage

- Strong written and spoken English with proactive communication



COMPENSATION:



Phase 1 = TESTING

Smaller ad budget, part-time 15-20 hrs/week. Retainer $
USD/month flat. Low-budget single-channel pipeline, main workload is the backend tracking setup with our dev and automation manager.



Phase 2 = HEAVY SCALING Ad budget $
USD/day, heavy part-time. Retainer $
USD/month base plus performance bonuses. Multiple campaigns, split-test paths, second account turned on potentially.



Phase 3 = FULL-TIME IN HOUSE. 

Ad budget $1,000+ USD/day (~$30,000+/month), full-time 40 hrs/week. $1,200-1,500 USD/month base plus bonuses. Full focus, daily dashboard synthesis, both accounts, constant team comms.



HOW TO APPLY — change the word "EdTech" in the title to "STUDY"



MUST PROVIDE (or you won't be reviewed):



1. Summary of your high-precision parameter-tracking + Meta Ads experience

2. Case studies + redacted screenshots of EVERY relevant ad account you've personally run with spend, ROAS/CAC, results. Plus contactable references.

3. YOUR STRATEGY FOR MY ACCOUNTS, IN DEPTH. Knowing I run a personal brand selling to both students and parents, with two funnel paths (AI DM closer vs direct-to-trial): walk me through how you'd structure the campaigns on EACH platform (IG and FB), targeting (broad vs interest, and how do you separate student-targeting from parent-targeting within one account), Advantage+/CBO/ABO usage, Lookalike sources from my data, and how you'd run the $50/day test across all of it and how you'd also scale the spending to each phase and ad spend. I want to see how you think about MY setup specifically.

title: Fast-Turnaround TikTok Editor – $10 Per Video | Simple Edits
description:
I’m a software engineer and content creator looking for a long-term TikTok video editor for fast-turnaround, real-time content.



This role is different from heavily edited TikTok work.



The videos will mainly be me talking directly to the camera about current topics in tech, software engineering, careers, job searching, opportunities, news, and other things happening in real time.



The editing itself will be relatively simple.



The main priority for this role is SPEED.



PAY:



$10 per fully edited TikTok.



This is a per-video position, NOT an hourly position.



The $10 rate includes the completed edit and reasonable small revisions needed to get the video approved.



THE EDITING STYLE:



Most videos will mainly require:



* Clean cuts

* Removing pauses and dead space

* Captions

* Basic zooms and punch-ins

* Simple pacing improvements

* Adding images or article snippets when needed

* Basic supporting visuals

* Minor audio cleanup

* Simple sound effects when appropriate



These are NOT intended to be heavily edited TikToks.



I will often provide the images, article screenshots, snippets, links, or other assets needed for the video. The goal is not to spend hours creating complicated edits.



The goal is to take a talking-head video, clean it up, make it engaging and easy to watch, and send it back quickly.



WHY SPEED MATTERS:



A lot of these videos will be about topics happening in real time.



Because of that, speed is the most important part of this role.



I may record a TikTok about something happening that day and need the edited version back quickly so I can review it, request any small changes, and post it while the topic is still relevant.



I am looking for someone who can:



* See a new video assignment quickly

* Begin working on it soon

* Return the first edit quickly

* Respond quickly if I have a question

* Handle small revisions quickly

* Communicate immediately if there is a problem



For many assignments, I will need the first edit returned the same day or by the next day.



Communication is extremely important for this role.



This is NOT a good fit for someone who regularly takes 1–2 days just to respond to a message.



I need someone who checks messages frequently while an active video is being worked on and can communicate quickly during the editing and revision process.



WORKLOAD:



The number of TikToks will vary depending on how much I record.



Some weeks may have approximately 3 videos.



Other weeks may have 4 or more.



There is no guaranteed number of videos every week.



However, I am looking for a long-term editor who I can consistently send this type of fast-turnaround content to whenever I record it.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR:



* Experience editing TikToks, Reels, or YouTube Shorts

* Fast turnaround

* Very responsive communication

* Strong understanding of talking-head content

* Clean captions

* Good pacing

* Ability to remove unnecessary pauses and dead space

* Ability to follow simple editing instructions

* Ability to complete small revisions quickly

* Reliability

* Interest in a long-term working relationship



You do NOT need to create an extremely complicated edit for every video.



For this role, a clean edit delivered quickly is more valuable than an over-edited video delivered too late.



TO APPLY:



Start your application with the word “Speed” so I know you read the entire job post.



Please do not send a generic application.



For this position, I will prioritize editors who are reliable, communicate quickly, and understand that speed is the most important part of the role.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right editor.

title: Experienced 3D Modeler for Bambu Studio / FDM Printing – Long-Term Partner (Fiverr Refugee)
description:
About the Project & Mission:

Hi there! I am a "Fiverr refugee" looking to completely move away from the platform and build a direct, long-term working relationship with a talented designer in the Philippines. I’ve known several Filipino people throughout my life and have always deeply appreciated the incredible energy, warmth, and positive culture.



I run a startup called Linus Labs where I create custom 3D-printed products (like sports hype chains and logo items). Every single project I work on feeds into my ultimate goal: funding a future animal sanctuary. Down the line, I also plan to launch a specialized line of custom files celebrating people’s pets (both living and deceased). If you are an animal lover who wants your work to contribute to a meaningful cause, this is the place for you.



Because I am just starting out, my budget for the regular, ongoing files will be on the lower/minimum side at first. However, as the business grows, I am fully committed to taking care of the people who helped me build it—I want this work to genuinely impact you and your family long-term.



What I Need (The Workflow):

I am looking for a professional—no beginners or people just trying it out, please. Given enough time, I am fully capable of handling the 3D modeling myself. The only reason I am outsourcing this work is to save time so I can focus on scaling other areas of my business. Because of this, the files must be 100% plug-and-play.



When you deliver a project, I need to be able to download it, rename it, open it directly in Bambu Studio, and hit print without messing around with bad geometry, messy scaling, or fixing unprintable files. If I have to spend time fixing the file, it defeats the purpose of hiring a professional.



The Pipeline: I have 10 or so projects ready to go within the next couple of weeks, followed by sporadic projects over time.



The First Project: The very first task is a challenging logo conversion, but it is completely doable for an experienced designer. Because it is complex, I am paying a premium for this first file.



Future Projects: We will establish a fair, agreed-upon baseline price for simple files to keep a steady flow of work going, and I will always pay a premium for the highly complex ones.



Requirements:

Proven experience designing explicitly for FDM 3D printing.



Full proficiency in creating and optimizing projects directly for Bambu Studio.



Clean topology, manifold/watertight models, and a solid understanding of how to make files easily scalable while keeping them perfectly proportional.



Excellent communication and a positive attitude.



How to Apply:

Please reply with a link to your portfolio showing 3D prints you have successfully modeled. Bonus points if you have experience converting 2D logos into clean 3D objects. Please mention your favorite animal at the top of your reply so I know you read the whole post!



Looking forward to building a great partnership together.
